CITY OF SAN MARINO

  CITY COUNCIL AGENDA

Susan Jakubowski, Mayor  www.cityofsanmarino.org
Steve Talt, Vice Mayor  (626) 300-0700 Phone
Steven W. Huang, DDS, Council Member  (626) 300-0709 Fax
Gretchen Shepherd Romey, Council Member  City Hall Council Chamber
Ken Ude, Council Member  2200 Huntington Drive
Marcella Marlowe, Ph.D., City Manager  San Marino, CA 91108

  REGULAR MEETING OF THE
  SAN MARINO CITY COUNCIL
  WEDNESDAY, FEBRUARY 9, 2022 AT 6:00 P.M.
  SAN MARINO CENTER
  1800 HUNTINGTON DRIVE
  SAN MARINO, CA 91108

The City of San Marino appreciates your attendance. Citizens’ interest provides the Council with
valuable information regarding issues of the community.

Regular meetings are held on the 2nd Wednesday of every month at 6:00 p.m. Typically, adjourned
meetings are held on the last Friday of every month at 8:30 a.m.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who requires
a reasonable modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact
the City Clerk via email at cityclerk@cityofsanmarino.org or by phone at (626) 300-0705 prior
to the meeting for assistance.

  PURSUANT TO ASSEMBLY BILL 361 (AB 361)
Members of the City Council may teleconference into the meeting without noticing each
teleconference location from which a member will be participating in a public meeting.

  CORONAVIRUS DISEASE (COVID-19) ADVISORY
To protect both staff, our constituents, and elected officials, members of the public must follow
the State and County Health Department’s current Health Officer Orders, which require wearing
a mask indoors. Given the seriousness of COVID-19, you are encouraged to watch or listen to
the meeting from home, or provide input electronically, if you do not feel comfortable attending
in person.
 CITY COUNCIL AGENDA – FEBRUARY 9, 2022  PAGE 2 OF 6

How to view or listen to the meeting from home:
  1) Via Computer for Video Streaming:
  Website: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/89792171927
  Meeting ID: 897 9217 1927
  2) Via Phone for Audio Only:
  Phone Number: (669) 900-9128
  Meeting ID: 897 9217 1927

How to offer public comment from home:

  1) Public comment will be accepted by email to cityclerk@cityofsanmarino.org until 3:00
  p.m. the day of the meeting, to be read by the City Clerk during public comment. Lengthy
  public comment may be summarized in the interest of time. Any comments received after
  3:00 p.m. will be included in the public comment record but will not be read at the
  meeting.
  2) Public comment will be accepted electronically via the zoom.us teleconference module
  during the meeting. Zoom comments will be taken after the in-person comments.

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL:  Council Member Huang, Council Member Shepherd Romey, Council
  Member Ude, Vice Mayor Talt, and Mayor Jakubowski

POSTING OF AGENDA

The agenda is posted 72 hours prior to each meeting at the following locations: City Hall, 2200
Huntington Drive, the Crowell Public Library, 1890 Huntington Drive, and the Stoneman Building,
1560 Pasqualito Drive.  The agenda is also posted on the City’s website:
http://www.cityofsanmarino.org.

PUBLIC COMMENTS

The City welcomes public input. Members of the public may address the City Council by
completing a public comment card and giving it to the City Clerk prior to the meeting. At this
time, the public may address the City Council on items that are not on the agenda. Pursuant to
state law, the City Council may not discuss or take action on issues not on the meeting agenda
(Government Code Section 54954.2). The Mayor reserves the right to place limits on duration
of comments. Staff may be asked to follow up on such items.

CITY MANAGER’S REPORT

This is an opportunity for the City Manager to inform the City Council and the public of any
upcoming events or matters of interest to the community.
 CITY COUNCIL AGENDA – FEBRUARY 9, 2022  PAGE 3 OF 6

  PRESENTATION

1. ACKNOWLEDGEMENT OF SAN  MARINO  LIBRARY  FOUNDATION
  BOOKMARK CONTEST WINNER

2. PRESENTATION FROM ATHENS SERVICES ON SB 1383, CALIFORNIA’S
  SHORT-LIVED CLIMATE POLLUTANT REDUCTION LAW

  PUBLIC HEARING

3. CONSIDERATION OF A RECOMMENDATION FROM THE CITY OF SAN
  MARINO PLANNING COMMISSION TO CERTIFY THE PROPOSED INITIAL
  STUDY/NEGATIVE DECLARATION AND ADOPT THE 2021-2029 HOUSING
  ELEMENT UPDATE (6TH CYCLE - AS AMENDED) OF THE SAN MARINO
  GENERAL PLAN FOR SUBMITTAL TO THE STATE DEPARTMENT OF
  COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT (HCD) FOR FINAL REVIEW CONSISTENT
  WITH STATE HOUSING LAW

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council adopt Resolution No. R-22-06
  Certifying the Proposed Initial Study/Negative Declaration and Adopting the 2021-2029
  Housing Element Update (6th Cycle- As Amended) of the San Marino General Plan.

  NEW BUSINESS

4. RECEIVE AND FILE FINANCIAL REPORT FOR SECOND QUARTER
  (OCTOBER 2021 THROUGH DECEMBER 2021)

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council receive and file the financial report
  reflecting the City’s revenues and expenditures as of December 31, 2021.

5. REVIEW OF FISCAL YEAR 2021-22 MID-YEAR FINANCIAL REVIEW,
  UPDATED FIVE-YEAR FINANCIAL FORECAST AND LONG-TERM
  FINANCIAL PROJECTS, AND APPROVAL OF BUDGET AMENDMENTS

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council receive and file the FY 2021-22
  Mid-Year Financial Review, Updated Five-Year Financial Forecast and Long-Term Financial
  Projections, and approve the budget amendments as noted in the Staff Report.
 CITY COUNCIL AGENDA – FEBRUARY 9, 2022  PAGE 4 OF 6

6. AGREEMENT BETWEEN THE CITY OF SAN MARINO AND ALL CITY
  MANAGEMENT SERVICES, INC. FOR CROSSING GUARD SERVICES

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council approve the agreement between
  the City of San Marino and All City Management Services, Inc. for crossing guard services
  beginning July 1, 2021 and ending June 30, 2023, and appropriate funds in the amount of
  $18,772 to the Other Contract Services account 103-30-4150-0000.

7. APPROVAL OF STRIPING AND SIGNING MODIFICATIONS TO IMPROVE
  VEHICULAR SAFETY ALONG WESTBOUND HUNTINGTON DRIVE
  BETWEEN MONTEREY ROAD AND WESTHAVEN ROAD

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council approve the striping, signing, and
  pavement marking modifications as recommended by the City’s traffic engineer for
  westbound Huntington Drive between Monterey Road and Westhaven Road.

  CONSENT CALENDAR

8. RECEIVE AND FILE THE MONTHLY DISBURSEMENTS REPORT FOR
  JANUARY 2021

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council receive and file the Monthly
  Disbursements Report for the month of January 2021.

9. RECEIVE AND FILE CASH AND INVESTMENT REPORT FOR DECEMBER
  2021

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council receive and file the Cash and
  Investment Report for the month of December 2021.

10. APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council approve the special meeting of
  January 12, 2022, the regular meeting of January 12, 2022, and the adjourned regular meeting
  of January 28, 2022.

11. ADOPTION OF RESOLUTION NO. R-22-04 TO CONTINUE HYBRID PUBLIC
  MEETINGS PURSUANT TO AB 361

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council adopt Resolution No. R-22-04 re-
  authorizing the City Council and the City’s Boards and Commissions to continue
  teleconference accessibility for conducting public meetings pursuant to AB 361.

12. UPDATE ON CITY RESPONSE TO THE COVID-19 PANDEMIC

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council receive and file the February 9,
  2022 report on the City’s response to the COVID-19 Pandemic.
 CITY COUNCIL AGENDA – FEBRUARY 9, 2022  PAGE 5 OF 6

13. APPROVAL OF RESOLUTION NO. R-22-03 APPROVING THE FILING OF AN
  APPLICATION FOR SB 1383 LOCAL ASSISTANCE GRANT FUNDS FROM
  CALRECYCLE
  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council approve Resolution No. R-22-03
  approving the filing of an application for SB 1383 Local Assistance Grant funds from the
  California Department of Resources Recycling and Recovery.

14. APPROVAL OF MODIFICATION OF FY 2021-22 CAPITAL EQUIPMENT
  FUND AND AIR DISTRICT FUND BUDGETS FOR PURCHASE AND
  OUTFITTING OF POLICE VEHICLES

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council direct the Finance Director to
  amend the FY 2021-22 Air District budget (Account 212-30-4613-0500) from $70,000 to
  $73,400, and the FY 2021-22 Capital Equipment budget (Account 591-30-4613-0594) for the
  Detective Car Replacement from $12,000 to $15,000, for a total of $6,400 in additional
  expenditures.

15. ACCEPTANCE OF $2,000 DONATION  FROM  THE  SAN  MARINO
  COMMUNITY ATHLETICS ASSOCIATION
  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council (1) accept the donation of $2,000
  from the San Marino Community Athletics Association; (2) approve the fiscal year 2021-22
  revenue budget amendment to recognize revenue of $2,000 in the Restricted Donations Fund
  at Account 281-66-3601-0002 (Track Meet Donations) and; (3) approve the fiscal year 2021-
  22 expenditure budget amendment of $2,000 in the Restricted Donations Fund at Account
  281-66-4376-0002 (Track Meet Materials & Supplies).

16. ACCEPTANCE OF $1,000 AND $2,725 DONATIONS FROM THE SAN
  MARINO PUBLIC LIBRARY FOUNDATION

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council (1) accept the donation of $1,000
  from the San Marino Public Library Foundation; (2) approve the fiscal year 2021-22 revenue
  budget amendment to recognize revenue of $1,000 in the Restricted Donations Fund at
  Account 281-91-3601-0000 (Adult Material Donations – Other); (3) approve the fiscal year
  2021-22 expenditure budget amendment of $1,000 in the Restricted Donations Fund at
  Account 281-91-4370-0000 (Adult Materials – Other); (4) accept the donation of $2,725 from
  the San Marino Public Library Foundation; (5) approve the fiscal year 2021-22 revenue budget
  amendment to recognize revenue of $2,725 in the Restricted Donations Fund at Account
  281-92-3601-0000 (Children’s Materials Donations) and; (6) approve the fiscal year 2021-22
  expenditure budget amendment of $2,725 in the Restricted Donations Fund at Account 281-
  92-4370-0000 (Children’s Materials – Other).
 CITY COUNCIL AGENDA – FEBRUARY 9, 2022  PAGE 6 OF 6

WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS OR PUBLIC WRITINGS DISTRIBUTED

This is an opportunity to announce any written communications pertaining to the City received
by members of the City Council. All public writings distributed by the City of San Marino to at
least a majority of the City Council regarding any item on this agenda will be made available at
the Public Counter at City Hall located at 2200 Huntington Drive, San Marino, California 91108,
and will also be included in the public agenda packet that will available for review at the City
Council meeting.

PUBLIC COMMENTS

FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS

ADJOURNMENT

Dated: February 4, 2022  CHRISTINA BAKER
Posted: February 4, 2022  CITY CLERK
